Smriti Mandhana Takes Captaincy for India's T20 Revamp

Smriti Mandhana has begun her captaincy for the Indian women's T20 cricket team, marking a new era for the squad. The team is aiming for a revamp under her leadership, with their first series under the new captaincy commencing against Zimbabwe.
